5ca670f6593a5d78f0e85aed: Joan (Tracee Ellis Ross) unexpectedly proposes to Aaron (guest star Richard T. Jones), but when he stumbles on his response, Joan decides the relationship is over and walks away.
When Joan buys an expensive new kitchen range for their new house, her fiance Aaron gets upset that she spent money without discussing it with him.

In order to prevent Aaron from going to Iraq, Joan kidnaps him and takes him to Mexico. In Mexico, Aaron explains to Joan that he cannot run away from the war and suggests they get married before he leaves.

When Lynn meets Xander, a cute student at UCLA, he asks her to perform at a rally raising awareness to save the environment. But when Lynn's manager gets her a gig at the House of Blues for the same day, she must decide where she will perform.
Maya tries to avoid calls from her publisher when she experiences writer's block and is unable to complete her third book.
When Maya accuses Darnell of blaming her for the miscarriage, Joan and Lynn are worried that Maya is in denial and not allowing herself to grieve.

The more things change, the more things stay the same, as new Devil Girl dancers step into the arena for a chance at stardom. New rivalries form on and off the court, as the LA Devils nation deals with growing pains, adversity and the challenge....

German makes a surprise return to Devils Nation, at a crisis point for Derek. The rivalry between Jamie and London heats up, as does the sexual tension between Jude and Noah. Jelena's dealt a major blow.
Mary Jane is devastated when she learns an interviewee died of suicide. SNC reacts by suspending Talk Back, putting Mark in an uncomfortable position. (S2, ep7)
Mary Jane and her colleagues are rocked by a fatal Atlanta school shooting. (S2, ep8)
Mary Jane gets nominated for an Emmy, prompting her to seek advice from her trusted friends. She must decide whether to take a chance and follow her instincts. (S2, ep9)
While Cynthia is out due to illness, Mary Jane and Kara host and produce a primetime news hour. In other events, Paul Jr. decides between job offers. (S2, ep10)
A recovering alcoholic professor trying to put his life back together is offered an escape from his reality by a seductive new student with a secret.
A happy couple on the verge of marriage have their plans derailed when David comes across the love that got away from his past.

Tracey's attempt to expose Connor to the world of performance poetry ends disastrously; things go from bad to worse at a family dinner when Cynthia gets drunk for the first time and shares some big news with the family.

Tracey's mother kicks her out, so she moves in with her best friend, Candice, and Esther, but soon drives them crazy; a pre-menstrual Tracey must stop her sister Cynthia from marrying Tracey's own gay ex-fiancé, Ronald.
Tracey's return to the Estate isn't as easy as she would like.
Tracey sets out to move back home whilst replacing Connor and Candice.
Tracey wants some company, and her cousin, Boy Tracy has a plan.
Tracey and Mandy seek to prove that the internet can be used for more than just sex.
An eating disorder, personal stories, and anger issues all work to bond the roommates. But how long will all the love and support last?

The College Hill cast is once again falling apart at the seams, even as the ever-blossoming love stories continue to grow.  Kyle's homesickness gets the best of him and he flips out- threatening to leave the show for good.

Judge Ms. Pat settles cases that features cousins whose cruise plans sunk, former friends fighting over a missing monkey...finger monkey and a mother & daughter's dispute over a phone bill way past due

Pippi suddenly realizes that she is eventually going to grow up.  This is not a prospect she likes and as she thinks about her future, we see her fears realized as we flash forward to a bleak future as a grown-up.

In a desperate attempt to get the crystals back from the KFDP, Skor SHRINKS down his hapless brother Skrap and sends him to infiltrate the KFDP headquarters. As Skrap is taking off with a crystal, a very tired Chow accidentally eats him!

When Master Mayhem tries to upload a cool new viral video, he totally #fails, and now everybody on planet Earth is laughing at him!  So he’s sending Teensy the Tri-Terror-Tops to pulverize our planet, and delete the internet.

Desperate to make amends to his old friend, Hot Shot allows Wheeljack to shoot him, but this isn't enough. Wheeljack takes Sideswipe hostage, but Hot Shot rescues him. On the moon, Megatron welcomes Wheeljack to the Decepticons.

My Goldfish is Evil: The Army Of Sea Dudes
With Mom noticing a certain "tension" between Beanie and his goldfish, she encourages Beanie to act more friendly around him, and that they try working on a project together.
